thread:
claire-docs: opening a small PR to add a migration note for customers moving HSM keywraps when they switch from shared KMS to dedicated HSMs in private deploys. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2015

mike-engr: great. pls include the zero-downtime pattern we used: create new key on HSM, wrap existing envelope keys with the new HSM key, then rotate pointers. a short diagram or ordered list helps.

claire-docs: will do. planning a step list + a tiny python example for re-wrapping envelope keys so platform engineers can adapt it. snippet: 
```python
# pseudo example: unwrap with old KMS client, wrap with hsm client
old_plain = old_kms.unwrap(envelope)
new_envelope = hsm_client.wrap(old_plain, key_id="hsm-key-1")
registry.update(envelope_id, new_envelope)
```

nisha-sre: add networking notes: if HSM sits in a separate subnet you need the egress rules for the HSM management port (TCP 15001) and the outbound proxy exceptions for the upgrading host. include both security-group and iptables examples.

claire-docs: adding both. sg example: `aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-... --protocol tcp --port 15001 --cidr 10.2.0.0/24`. iptables example: `iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp -d 10.2.0.5 --dport 15001 -j ACCEPT`. will also mention sealed-site NAT edge cases.

mike-engr: also call out HSM vendor caveat: some HSMs require a local admin session to be open during key import. note the command and that it may require PKCS11 pin. customers keep missing that.

claire-docs: good call 1. adding a one-liner troubleshooting table: symptom -> likely cause -> quick fix. e.g. "wrap API returns 403" -> missing mgmt ACL on HSM -> ensure mgmt role assigned + restart import flow.

ci-bot: docs linkcheck failed on PR #2015 - anchor docs/private/hsm#migrate-keywrap -> 404.

claire-docs: thanks CI. i'll add an explicit anchor id and update any cross-links from legacy pages. also adding a short "what not to do" bullet: don't rewrap live tokens without updating cache TTLs, or you'll serve stale tokens.

nisha-sre: small addition: include a Python SDK example showing how to call the private API over TLS with mutual auth and how to fall back to a unix-socket on single-node installs. e.g. `requests` snippet for TLS and `requests_unixsocket` example.

claire-docs: adding both samples under "SDK examples". TLS snippet: 
```python
import requests
resp = requests.post('https://hsm.private.local/v1/wrap', cert=('client.crt','client.key'), json={})
```

unix socket snippet: 
```python
import requests_unixsocket
s = requests_unixsocket.Session()
resp = s.post('http+unix://%2Fvar%2Frun%2Fredwood%2Fhsm.sock/v1/health')
```

mike-engr: nice. one more: mention clock skew impact on HSM auth handshakes and recommend NTP preflight in the migration checklist. a lot of failures are clock-related.

claire-docs: added NTP preflight step and a sample `chronyc tracking` command. pushing changes now and tagging @mike-engr + @nisha-sre for quick review.

deploy-bot: deployed docs preview available at https://deploy.redwood.internal/docs/pr/2015-preview

claire-docs: merging once approvals are in. thanks team! :tada:
